title: dnd-5e-2024 shared definitions (SPEC.md §6.3)
description: Enums here mirror tables.json; tests/rulesets/dnd-5e-2024/schemas.test.ts keeps them in step.

Ability.description: An ability, by its three-letter key.

Dice.description: Dice with no modifier, such as "2d6". Modifiers come from an ability and a bonus.

Damage.description: One damage roll. In a list, the first is the primary damage and the rest render as "plus" riders.

dice.description: The damage dice. A damage entry has dice or a flat amount.

amount.description: Flat damage printed without dice, such as "1 Piercing damage".

bonus.description: A flat addition to the modifier: a deliberate deviation, listed as a warning.

type.description: The damage type. A damage entry has a type or a note.

condition.description: When a rider applies, printed after it: "if the attack roll had Advantage". Only on a rider, never the first damage.

note.description: Printed after "damage" in place of a type, for damage whose type isn't fixed: "of the type chosen for the Draconic Origin trait".

Proficiency.description: Proficient adds the proficiency bonus; expertise adds twice it.

Adjust.description: A deliberate deviation from a derived value, listed as a warning for the reviewer.

Ref.description: A link to a library entry. It renders the target's current name, linked to its page.

note.description: A qualifier printed in parentheses after the target's name, such as "level 5 version".

RefOrText.description: A ref to a library entry, or a plain string for SRD content not in the library.

Text.description: Rules text in the markdown subset, with tokens where the ruleset allows them.

Line.description: A stat block line, written as printed.

StatBlockItem.description: A named trait or action of an embedded stat block.

StatBlock.description: A stat block printed inside a spell or magic item (SPEC.md §6.6, §6.7). Authored as printed: only the ability modifiers and saves are derived.

typeLine.description: Size, type, and alignment, such as "Large Dragon, Neutral".

abilities.description: Ability scores. The modifiers and saves are derived.
